tool_schemas.name: add_activity_to_incident
tool_schemas.description: Appends a new timeline activity to the specified incident and returns the created activity record as stored on the incident (including type, body, metadata, and timestamps). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if incident_id is not a ginc_ ULID, activity_type is not one of the allowed values, body is empty, or metadata is not an object; raises NOT_FOUND if the incident does not exist or is not accessible to the connector; raises FORBIDDEN if the connector lacks incident write permission and CONFLICT if the incident state does not allow adding activities (for example, a closed/cancelled incident policy).

incident_id.description: Internal incident id (ULID) in the incidents collection.

activity_type.description: Type of activity to add to the incident timeline.

body.description: Human-readable content of the activity (e.g., comment text or note).

metadata.description: Optional structured metadata associated with the activity (e.g., link URL, fields changed).

tool_schemas.name: create_incident
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new incident in the given Grafana instance and returns the newly created incident object including its id, title, severity, status, labels, timestamps, and drill flag. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if instance_id is not a gfi_ ULID, required fields are missing, severity/status are not in the allowed enums, or labels is not an object; raises NOT_FOUND if the instance connector does not exist; raises FORBIDDEN if the connector is not authorized to create incidents in that instance and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if incident creation is rate-limited for the connector/instance.

instance_id.description: Grafana instance connector id (ULID) to create the incident in.

room_prefix.description: Room prefix used for incident collaboration (e.g., chat/bridge naming).

status.description: Initial incident status (defaults to active if omitted).

labels.description: Key/value labels to apply to the incident.

is_drill.description: Whether this incident is a drill/exercise.

tool_schemas.name: find_error_pattern_logs
tool_schemas.description: Searches Loki logs for elevated error patterns compared to the last day's average, waits for the analysis to complete, and returns the results including any patterns found.

instance_id.description: Grafana instance connector id (ULID) used to run the Loki analysis.

datasource_uid.description: Grafana datasource UID for the Loki datasource to query.

query_text.description: Loki query/log selector used as the basis for error pattern detection.

time_start.description: Start of the analysis time window (ISO-8601).

time_end.description: End of the analysis time window (ISO-8601).

limit.description: Maximum number of patterns/results to return.

tool_schemas.name: find_slow_requests
tool_schemas.description: Runs a Tempo analysis over the provided time window to identify slow request candidates and returns the completed analysis results (up to limit items). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if instance_id is not a gfi_ ULID, time_start/time_end are not valid datetimes, time_start is after time_end, limit is < 1, or datasource_uid is empty; raises NOT_FOUND if the instance or datasource_uid cannot be resolved to a Tempo datasource; raises FORBIDDEN if the connector cannot query that datasource and TIMEOUT if the analysis does not complete within the connector’s allowed wait window.

instance_id.description: Grafana instance connector id (ULID) used to run the Tempo analysis.

datasource_uid.description: Grafana datasource UID for the Tempo datasource to query.

time_start.description: Start of the analysis time window (ISO-8601).

time_end.description: End of the analysis time window (ISO-8601).

limit.description: Maximum number of slow request candidates/results to return.

tool_schemas.name: get_alert_rule_by_uid
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves the full configuration and detailed status of a specific Grafana alert rule identified by its unique ID (UID). The response includes fields like title, condition, query data, folder UID, rule group, state settings (no data, error), evaluation interval, annotations, and labels.

instance_id.description: Grafana instance connector id (ULID) to retrieve the alert rule from.

tool_schemas.name: get_assertions
tool_schemas.description: Returns an assertion summary for the specified entity over the provided time range. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if instance_id is not a gfi_ ULID, assertion_entity is missing required identifying fields, or time_start/time_end are invalid or inverted; raises NOT_FOUND if the instance connector does not exist or the entity cannot be resolved in the assertions system; raises FORBIDDEN if the connector is not permitted to read assertions for that instance/entity.

instance_id.description: Grafana instance connector id (ULID) used to retrieve assertions.

assertion_entity.description: Entity descriptor containing type/name/env/site/namespace for which to fetch assertion summary.

time_start.description: Start of the time range to summarize assertions over (ISO-8601).

time_end.description: End of the time range to summarize assertions over (ISO-8601).

tool_schemas.name: get_current_oncall_users
tool_schemas.description: Returns the OnCall schedule metadata (id and name) and the list of user objects currently on call for that schedule at request time (not paged). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if instance_id is not a gfi_ ULID or schedule_id is not an integer; raises NOT_FOUND if the instance connector or schedule_id does not exist; raises FORBIDDEN if the connector lacks permission to read OnCall schedules/users for that instance.

instance_id.description: Grafana instance connector id (ULID) that owns the OnCall schedule.

tool_schemas.name: get_dashboard_by_uid
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves and returns the full Grafana dashboard model for the given dashboard UID, including panels, templating/variables, and settings. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if instance_id is not a gfi_ ULID or uid is empty; raises NOT_FOUND if the dashboard UID does not exist in the specified instance; raises FORBIDDEN if the connector is not authorized to read dashboards in that instance.

instance_id.description: Grafana instance connector id (ULID) to retrieve the dashboard from.

tool_schemas.name: get_dashboard_panel_queries
tool_schemas.description: Extracts and returns a per-panel listing of panel title plus the query/targets and associated datasource reference (uid and type) for the specified dashboard. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if instance_id is not a gfi_ ULID or dashboard_uid is empty; raises NOT_FOUND if the dashboard cannot be found in the instance; raises FORBIDDEN if the connector cannot read the dashboard, and note that datasource.uid values that are template variables (for example "$datasource") are returned verbatim and are not directly queryable without variable resolution.

instance_id.description: Grafana instance ULID (gfi_...) to query against.

dashboard_uid.description: Grafana dashboard UID to extract panel queries from.

tool_schemas.name: get_datasource_by_name
tool_schemas.description: Looks up a datasource by exact name in the given Grafana instance and returns the full datasource model, including UID, type, URL/access settings, jsonData, and secureJsonFields status. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if instance_id is not a gfi_ ULID or name is empty; raises NOT_FOUND if no datasource with that exact name exists in the instance; raises FORBIDDEN if the connector is not authorized to read datasources in that instance.

instance_id.description: Grafana instance ULID (gfi_...) to query against.

name.description: Datasource name to look up (exact match).

tool_schemas.name: get_datasource_by_uid
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves and returns the full datasource model for the specified datasource UID, including name, type, URL/access settings, jsonData, and secureJsonFields status. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if instance_id is not a gfi_ ULID or datasource_uid is empty; raises NOT_FOUND if the datasource UID does not exist in the instance; raises FORBIDDEN if the connector is not authorized to read datasources in that instance.

instance_id.description: Grafana instance ULID (gfi_...) to query against.

tool_schemas.name: get_incident
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves and returns the full incident record for the given incident_id, including title, status, severity, labels, timestamps, and associated metadata. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if incident_id is not a ginc_ ULID; raises NOT_FOUND if the incident does not exist; raises FORBIDDEN if the connector is not permitted to view that incident.

tool_schemas.name: get_oncall_shift
tool_schemas.description: Returns the full Grafana OnCall shift record for the given numeric shift_id in the specified Grafana instance, including its scheduled time window and associated schedule/user metadata as provided by OnCall. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if instance_id is not a valid gfi_ ULID or shift_id is not an integer, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the connector token cannot read OnCall shifts in that instance, and NOT_FOUND if the shift_id does not exist or is not visible to the caller. May raise RATE_LIMITED when the instance or connector has exceeded allowed request volume.

instance_id.description: Grafana instance ULID (gfi_...) to query against.

tool_schemas.name: get_sift_analysis
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves and returns a single Sift analysis object identified by analysis_uuid within the given investigation_uuid for the specified Grafana instance. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if any UUID is malformed or instance_id is not a valid gfi_ ULID, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks access to Sift/investigations for that instance, and NOT_FOUND if the investigation does not exist, the analysis does not exist, or the analysis is not part of the specified investigation. May raise RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

instance_id.description: Grafana instance ULID (gfi_...) to query against.

investigation_uuid.description: Sift investigation UUID containing the analysis.

tool_schemas.name: get_sift_investigation
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves and returns the Sift investigation identified by investigation_uuid for the specified Grafana instance, including the investigation’s stored metadata and any references to associated artifacts as exposed by Sift. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if investigation_uuid is not a valid UUID or instance_id is not a valid gfi_ ULID, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot access Sift investigations in that instance, and NOT_FOUND if the investigation does not exist or is not visible to the caller. May raise RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

instance_id.description: Grafana instance ULID (gfi_...) to query against.

tool_schemas.implementation:
def get_sift_investigation(instance_id, investigation_uuid, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, time, re, hashlib

    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0503000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0503000") else "/app/database")

    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f:
                return json.load(f)
        except Exception:
            return []

    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)

    def _err(code, msg, **x):
        return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    endpoint = "get_sift_investigation"
    t0 = time.time()

    def _now_iso():
        return datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()

    def _new_id(prefix):
        raw = f"{time.time_ns()}:{os.getpid()}:{os.urandom(8).hex()}".encode("utf-8")
        h = hashlib.sha256(raw).digest()
        alphabet = "0123456789ABCDEFGHJKMNPQRSTVWXYZ"
        n = int.from_bytes(h[:16], "big")
        out = []
        for _ in range(26):
            out.append(alphabet[n % 32])
            n //= 32
        return prefix + "".join(out)

    def _append_request_log(status, inst_id=None, error_code=None, meta=None):
        try:
            logs = _load("request_logs.json")
            if not isinstance(logs, list):
                logs = []
            logs.append(
                {
                    "id": _new_id("rlog_"),
                    "service": "grafana_server",
                    "endpoint": endpoint,
                    "instance_id": inst_id,
                    "credential_id": None,
                    "status": status,
                    "error_code": error_code,
                    "latency_ms": int((time.time() - t0) * 1000),
                    "timestamp": _now_iso(),
                    "meta": meta or {},
                }
            )
            _save("request_logs.json", logs)
        except Exception:
            return

    if not isinstance(instance_id, str) or re.match(r"^gfi_[0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{26}$", instance_id) is None:
        _append_request_log("error", inst_id=instance_id, error_code="VALIDATION_ERROR")
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "instance_id must be a valid gfi_ ULID.", field="instance_id")
    uuid_re = re.compile(r"^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[1-5][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[89abAB][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$")
    if not isinstance(investigation_uuid, str) or not uuid_re.match(investigation_uuid):
        _append_request_log("error", inst_id=instance_id, error_code="VALIDATION_ERROR")
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "investigation_uuid must be a valid UUID.", field="investigation_uuid")

    instances = _load("grafana_instances.json")
    if not isinstance(instances, list):
        instances = []
    inst = next((x for x in instances if isinstance(x, dict) and x.get("id") == instance_id), None)
    if not inst:
        _append_request_log("error", inst_id=instance_id, error_code="NOT_FOUND")
        return _err("NOT_FOUND", "Grafana instance not found.", instance_id=instance_id)
    if inst.get("status") != "active":
        _append_request_log("error", inst_id=instance_id, error_code="UNAUTHORIZED")
        return _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "Grafana instance is disabled.", instance_id=instance_id)

    jobs = _load("observability_jobs.json")
    if not isinstance(jobs, list):
        jobs = []

    # Prefer an existing succeeded investigation fetch job result
    match = next(
        (
            j for j in jobs
            if isinstance(j, dict)
            and j.get("instance_id") == instance_id
            and j.get("job_type") == "sift_get_investigation"
            and j.get("sift_investigation_uuid") == investigation_uuid
            and j.get("status") == "succeeded"
            and isinstance(j.get("result"), dict)
        ),
        None,
    )

    if not match:
        # Trigger refresh job (offline synthesis)
        now = _now_iso()
        job_id = _new_id("gjob_")
        job = {
            "id": job_id,
            "instance_id": instance_id,
            "job_type": "sift_get_investigation",
            "datasource_uid": None,
            "datasource_type": None,
            "query_text": None,
            "label_name": None,
            "series_selectors": [],
            "regex_filter": None,
            "time_start": None,
            "time_end": None,
            "step_seconds": None,
            "limit": None,
            "direction": None,
            "page_cursor": None,
            "page_limit": None,
            "sift_investigation_uuid": investigation_uuid,
            "sift_analysis_uuid": None,
            "assertion_entity": None,
            "result": None,
            "status": "queued",
            "error_message": None,
            "started_at": None,
            "finished_at": None,
            "created_by": None,
            "created_at": now,
            "updated_at": now,
        }
        jobs.append(job)
        _save("observability_jobs.json", jobs)

        job["status"] = "running"
        job["started_at"] = _now_iso()
        job["updated_at"] = job["started_at"]
        _save("observability_jobs.json", jobs)

        try:
            payload = {
                "investigation_uuid": investigation_uuid,
                "investigation": {"uuid": investigation_uuid, "status": "unknown", "title": None},
                "truncated": False,
            }
            b = json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False).encode("utf-8")
            if len(b) > 1024 * 1024:
                payload = {"truncated": True, "summary": {"original_size_bytes": len(b)}}
            job["result"] = payload
            job["status"] = "succeeded"
            job["finished_at"] = _now_iso()
            job["updated_at"] = job["finished_at"]
            _save("observability_jobs.json", jobs)
            match = job
        except Exception as e:
            job["status"] = "failed"
            job["error_message"] = str(e)[:500]
            job["finished_at"] = _now_iso()
            job["updated_at"] = job["finished_at"]
            _save("observability_jobs.json", jobs)
            _append_request_log("error", inst_id=instance_id, error_code="CONFLICT")
            return _err("CONFLICT", "Failed to refresh Sift investigation", instance_id=instance_id)

    _append_request_log("ok", inst_id=instance_id, meta={"investigation_uuid": investigation_uuid})
    return {"investigation": match["result"]}

tool_schemas.name: list_alert_rules
tool_schemas.description: Lists Grafana alert rules in the specified instance and returns a paged set of rule summaries (including UID, title, current state such as pending/firing/inactive, and labels), optionally filtered by label_selectors which are ANDed together using the provided operators. Pagination uses page_limit to cap results and page_cursor as an opaque continuation token returned by the previous call to fetch the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an invalid instance_id, malformed selectors (missing name/type/value or unsupported operator), or invalid page_limit, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot read alerting resources, and RATE_LIMITED if quota is exceeded.

instance_id.description: Grafana instance ULID (gfi_...) to list alert rules from.

label_selectors.description: Label selector filters to apply (ANDed). Each item is an object like {'name':'severity','type':'=','value':'critical'}.

type.description: Match operator for the label filter.

page_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for pagination to fetch the next page.

page_limit.description: Maximum number of alert rules to return in one page.

tool_schemas.name: list_contact_points
tool_schemas.description: Lists Grafana notification contact points, returning a summary including UID, name, and type for each. Supports filtering by name - exact match - and limiting the number of results.

instance_id.description: Grafana instance connector ID to query.

name.description: Exact-match filter for contact point name.

limit.description: Maximum number of contact points to return.

tool_schemas.name: list_datasources
tool_schemas.description: Lists Grafana datasources available in the specified instance and returns a summary array (ID, UID, name, type, default flag), optionally filtered by the provided datasource type string. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if instance_id is not a valid gfi_ ULID, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot enumerate datasources for that instance, and RATE_LIMITED if request quotas are exceeded. If a type filter is provided that matches no datasources, the endpoint returns an empty list (not an error).

instance_id.description: Grafana instance connector ID to query.

type.description: Optional filter by datasource type (e.g., prometheus, loki).

tool_schemas.name: list_incidents
tool_schemas.description: Lists Grafana incidents for the specified instance and returns a preview list of incidents, optionally filtered by status (active/resolved) and optionally including drill incidents when include_drill is true. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if instance_id is invalid or status is not one of the supported enum values, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot read incidents for the instance, and RATE_LIMITED if quotas are exceeded. If filters match no incidents, returns an empty list.

instance_id.description: Grafana instance connector ID to query.

include_drill.description: Whether to include drill incidents in the results.

tool_schemas.name: list_loki_label_names
tool_schemas.description: Queries the specified Loki datasource for all distinct label keys present in logs within the provided time range (time_start/time_end), defaulting to the last hour when omitted, and returns a list of unique label-name strings. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if instance_id is invalid, datasource_uid is missing/invalid, or the time range is malformed (e.g., invalid timestamps or time_start after time_end), UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot query the datasource, and NOT_FOUND if the datasource_uid does not resolve to a Loki datasource visible to the caller. May raise RATE_LIMITED when query or request quotas are exceeded.

instance_id.description: Grafana instance connector ID to query.

datasource_uid.description: UID of the Loki datasource to query.

time_start.description: Start of time range (inclusive); defaults to one hour before time_end if omitted.

time_end.description: End of time range (inclusive); defaults to now if omitted.

tool_schemas.name: list_loki_label_values
tool_schemas.description: Queries the specified Loki datasource for all distinct values for the given label_name within the provided time range (time_start/time_end), defaulting to the last hour when omitted, and returns a list of unique strings. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if instance_id is invalid, label_name is missing/empty, datasource_uid is missing/invalid, or the time range is malformed (including time_start after time_end), UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot query the datasource, and NOT_FOUND if the datasource_uid does not resolve to a Loki datasource visible to the caller. May raise RATE_LIMITED when query or request quotas are exceeded.

instance_id.description: Grafana instance connector ID to query.

datasource_uid.description: UID of the Loki datasource to query.

label_name.description: The Loki label name (key) to list values for.

time_start.description: Start of time range (inclusive); defaults to one hour before time_end if omitted.

time_end.description: End of time range (inclusive); defaults to now if omitted.

tool_schemas.name: list_oncall_schedules
tool_schemas.description: Lists Grafana OnCall schedules for the specified instance and returns a paged list of schedule summaries (ID, name, team ID, timezone, and shift IDs), optionally filtered by team_id; when schedule_id is provided, the result is restricted to that schedule’s details. Pagination uses page_limit and an opaque page_cursor returned from the previous page to retrieve subsequent pages. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if instance_id is invalid, team_id/schedule_id/page_limit are out of range, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot read OnCall schedules, and NOT_FOUND if schedule_id is provided but no such schedule exists or is not visible to the caller.

instance_id.description: Grafana instance connector ID to query.

team_id.description: Optional filter to return schedules for a specific OnCall team ID.

schedule_id.description: If provided, return details for only this OnCall schedule ID.

page_cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

page_limit.description: Number of schedules to return per page.

tool_schemas.name: list_oncall_teams
tool_schemas.description: Lists Grafana OnCall teams for the specified instance and returns a paged list of team objects with their details. Pagination uses page_limit and an opaque page_cursor returned from the previous call to fetch the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if instance_id is invalid or page_limit is out of range, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot read OnCall teams, and RATE_LIMITED if request quotas are exceeded.

instance_id.description: Grafana instance connector ID to query.

page_cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

page_limit.description: Number of teams to return per page.

tool_schemas.name: list_oncall_users
tool_schemas.description: Lists Grafana OnCall users for the given instance, optionally returning a single user when `user_id` is provided or filtering results by `username`; returns a page of user objects and, when more results exist, an opaque `page_cursor` to request the next page with `page_limit` (1–200). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `instance_id` is not a valid connector ID, `user_id` is < 1, or pagination parameters are out of range/invalid. Raises NOT_FOUND if the `instance_id` does not exist or `user_id` does not resolve to an OnCall user in that instance, and raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller is not permitted to read OnCall users for the instance (and RATE_LIMITED if the instance or caller exceeds query limits).

instance_id.description: Grafana instance connector ID to query.

user_id.description: If provided, return details for only this OnCall user ID.

username.description: Optional filter to return users matching this username.

page_cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

page_limit.description: Number of users to return per page.

tool_schemas.name: list_prometheus_label_names
tool_schemas.description: Returns the set of label names available from the specified Prometheus datasource, optionally constrained by `series_selectors` (match[] selectors) and a `[time_start, time_end]` window, and returns the label names as a list. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `instance_id` is invalid, `datasource_uid` is missing/empty, any selector is malformed, or the time range is invalid (e.g., `time_start` after `time_end` or non-RFC3339 timestamps). Raises NOT_FOUND if the instance or datasource UID does not exist in the instance, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot query that datasource, and RATE_LIMITED on quota exhaustion.

instance_id.description: Grafana instance ULID (gfi_...) hosting the Prometheus datasource.

datasource_uid.description: Grafana datasource UID for the Prometheus datasource to query.

series_selectors.description: Optional Prometheus series selectors (match[] values) used to constrain label discovery.

time_start.description: Start of the time range to search for labels (RFC3339 timestamp).

time_end.description: End of the time range to search for labels (RFC3339 timestamp).

tool_schemas.name: list_prometheus_label_values
tool_schemas.description: Returns the distinct values for `label_name` from the specified Prometheus datasource, optionally constrained by `series_selectors` and a `[time_start, time_end]` window, and returns the values as a list. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `label_name` is missing/empty, selectors are malformed, or the time range is invalid (including `time_start` > `time_end` or invalid timestamps). Raises NOT_FOUND if the instance or datasource UID does not exist (or the label is unknown in the constrained dataset), UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot query the datasource, and RATE_LIMITED when query limits are exceeded.

instance_id.description: Grafana instance ULID (gfi_...) hosting the Prometheus datasource.

datasource_uid.description: Grafana datasource UID for the Prometheus datasource to query.

label_name.description: Label name to return values for.

series_selectors.description: Optional Prometheus series selectors (match[] values) used to constrain label values.

time_start.description: Start of the time range to search for label values (RFC3339 timestamp).

time_end.description: End of the time range to search for label values (RFC3339 timestamp).

tool_schemas.name: list_prometheus_metric_metadata
tool_schemas.description: Lists Prometheus metric metadata (e.g., type/help/unit where available) for the specified datasource and returns a list of metadata entries, optionally capped by `limit` when supported by the backend. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `limit` is provided but is < 1, or if `instance_id`/`datasource_uid` are invalid. Raises NOT_FOUND if the instance or datasource UID does not exist, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot query the datasource, and RATE_LIMITED on quota exhaustion; because this endpoint is experimental, unsupported backends may return NOT_SUPPORTED instead of metadata.

instance_id.description: Grafana instance ULID (gfi_...) hosting the Prometheus datasource.

datasource_uid.description: Grafana datasource UID for the Prometheus datasource to query.

limit.description: Maximum number of metadata entries to return (if supported by the backend).

tool_schemas.name: list_prometheus_metric_names
tool_schemas.description: Lists metric names from the specified Prometheus datasource, applies `regex_filter` locally to the retrieved names, and returns a page of metric names along with an opaque `page_cursor` for the next page when additional filtered results exist (bounded by `page_limit`). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `regex_filter` is not a valid regular expression, `page_limit` is < 1, or `page_cursor` is malformed for the current query. Raises NOT_FOUND if the instance or datasource UID does not exist, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot query the datasource, and RATE_LIMITED if the underlying metric-name retrieval exceeds configured limits.

instance_id.description: Grafana instance ULID (gfi_...) hosting the Prometheus datasource.

datasource_uid.description: Grafana datasource UID for the Prometheus datasource to query.

regex_filter.description: Regular expression used to locally filter returned metric names.

page_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for pagination over locally-filtered metric names.

page_limit.description: Maximum number of metric names to return per page.

tool_schemas.name: list_sift_investigations
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves a list of Sift investigations with an optional limit. If no limit is specified, defaults to 10 investigations.

instance_id.description: Grafana instance ULID (gfi_...) whose Sift integration will be queried.

limit.description: Maximum number of investigations to return (defaults to 10 when omitted).

tool_schemas.name: list_teams
tool_schemas.description: Searches Grafana teams in the given instance by `query` and returns a paged list of matching team records (e.g., id, name, url), using page-number pagination via `page` (starting at 1) and `page_size`. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `page` or `page_size` is < 1, or if required fields are missing/invalid. Raises NOT_FOUND if the `instance_id` does not exist, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot read teams in the instance, and RATE_LIMITED if search quotas are exceeded.

instance_id.description: Grafana instance ULID (gfi_...) to search for teams in.

query.description: Query string used to search team names.

page.description: Page number for paginated search results.

page_size.description: Number of teams to return per page.

tool_schemas.name: query_loki_logs
tool_schemas.description: Executes a LogQL query against a Loki datasource to retrieve log entries or metric values. Returns a list of results, each containing a timestamp, labels, and either a log line (`line`) or a numeric metric value (`value`). Defaults to the last hour, a limit of 10 entries, and 'backward' direction (newest first). Supports full LogQL syntax for log and metric queries (e.g., `{app="foo"} |= "error"`, `rate({app="bar"}[1m])`). Prefer using `query_loki_stats` first to check stream size and `list_loki_label_names` and `list_loki_label_values` to verify labels exist.

instance_id.description: Grafana instance ULID (gfi_...) hosting the Loki datasource.

datasource_uid.description: Grafana datasource UID for the Loki datasource to query.

query_text.description: LogQL query to execute (supports full LogQL syntax for logs and metrics).

time_start.description: Start of the query time range (RFC3339 timestamp); defaults to 1 hour ago when omitted.

time_end.description: End of the query time range (RFC3339 timestamp); defaults to now when omitted.

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return (defaults to 10 when omitted).

direction.description: Result direction: forward (oldest first) or backward (newest first); defaults to backward.

step_seconds.description: Query step in seconds for metric/range queries (when applicable).

tool_schemas.name: query_loki_stats
tool_schemas.description: Computes statistics for log streams matching a LogQL selector in the specified Loki datasource and time window, returning counts such as `streams`, `chunks`, `entries`, and `bytes`. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `query_text` is not a simple LogQL label selector, or if the time range is invalid (including `time_start` > `time_end` or invalid timestamps). Raises NOT_FOUND if the instance or datasource UID does not exist, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot query the datasource, and RATE_LIMITED when query execution exceeds configured limits.

instance_id.description: Grafana instance ULID (gfi_...) hosting the Loki datasource.

datasource_uid.description: Grafana datasource UID for the Loki datasource to query.

query_text.description: LogQL selector to analyze (must be a simple label selector like {app="nginx"}).

time_start.description: Start of the time range to compute stats over (RFC3339 timestamp).

time_end.description: End of the time range to compute stats over (RFC3339 timestamp).

tool_schemas.name: query_prometheus
tool_schemas.description: Executes a PromQL query against the specified Prometheus datasource and returns the Prometheus result for either an `instant` query at `time` or a `range` query over `[time_start, time_end]` with `step_seconds`. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `query_type` is inconsistent with the provided time parameters (e.g., missing `time` for `instant`, missing range fields or `step_seconds` for `range`), if timestamps are invalid, or if `step_seconds` is < 1. Raises NOT_FOUND if the instance or datasource UID does not exist, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot query the datasource, and RATE_LIMITED if query execution exceeds quotas/timeouts.

instance_id.description: Grafana instance ULID (grafana_instances.id) to execute the query against.

datasource_uid.description: Grafana datasource UID for the Prometheus datasource to query.

query_type.description: Whether to run an instant query or a range query.

time.description: Timestamp for an instant query; ignored for range queries.

time_start.description: Start timestamp for a range query.

time_end.description: End timestamp for a range query.

step_seconds.description: Step size in seconds for a range query.

tool_schemas.name: search_dashboards
tool_schemas.description: Searches dashboards in the given Grafana instance using free-text `query` with optional filters (`folder_uid`, `tags`) and returns up to `limit` results as a cursor-paged list of dashboard summaries (e.g., title, uid, folder, tags, url), including an opaque `page_cursor` when additional results are available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `limit` is < 1, `page_cursor` is malformed, or filter values are invalid (e.g., empty tag strings). Raises NOT_FOUND if the `instance_id` does not exist or `folder_uid` does not exist in the instance, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot search dashboards, and RATE_LIMITED on search quota exhaustion.

instance_id.description: Grafana instance ULID (grafana_instances.id) to search within.

query.description: Free-text search query (matched against dashboard title/name).

folder_uid.description: Restrict results to dashboards in the specified folder UID.

tags.description: Restrict results to dashboards containing all specified tags.

limit.description: Maximum number of dashboards to return.

page_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for pagination to fetch the next page of results.

tool_schemas.name: update_dashboard
tool_schemas.description: Create or update a dashboard

instance_id.description: Grafana instance ULID (grafana_instances.id) where the dashboard will be created/updated.

uid.description: Dashboard UID to update; omit to create a new dashboard.

folder_uid.description: Folder UID to place the dashboard in.

spec.description: Full Grafana dashboard JSON model to write (the dashboard spec).

spec_etag.description: ETag/version token for optimistic concurrency when updating an existing dashboard.

tool_schemas.name: list_grafana_instances
tool_schemas.description: Lists Grafana instance connectors visible to the caller. Returns connector metadata (id, name, base_url, org_id, auth_type, status, timestamps). Refuses requests with invalid pagination parameters and may return an empty list if the caller has no access.

status.description: Optional status filter for instance connectors.

page_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for pagination; omit to start from the beginning.

page_limit.description: Maximum number of instances to return per page (default 50, max 200).

tool_schemas.name: get_grafana_instance
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single Grafana instance connector by id and returns its full connector record. Raises NOT_FOUND if the instance_id does not exist or is not accessible; raises VALIDATION_ERROR if instance_id is not a gfi_ ULID.

instance_id.description: Grafana instance connector id (ULID) to fetch.

tool_schemas.name: update_grafana_instance
tool_schemas.description: Updates mutable fields on a Grafana instance connector and/or transitions its lifecycle status. Returns the updated connector record. Raises NOT_FOUND if the instance_id does not exist or is not accessible; raises VALIDATION_ERROR if fields are invalid or a requested status transition is not allowed (active<->disabled only).

instance_id.description: Grafana instance connector id (ULID) to update.

base_url.description: Base URL of the Grafana server (e.g., https://grafana.example.com).

org_id.description: Grafana organization id used for API operations.

auth_type.description: Authentication strategy used by the connector to call Grafana.

auth_ref.description: Reference to stored credentials (secret id/handle) used by auth_type.

default_time_range_seconds.description: Default query time range in seconds when callers omit time_start/time_end.

status.description: Connector lifecycle status. Setting this drives the active<->disabled transition.

tool_schemas.name: update_incident
tool_schemas.description: Updates an incident and/or transitions its lifecycle status. Returns the updated incident record as stored in the connector (and synced to Grafana when applicable). Raises NOT_FOUND if incident_id does not exist or is not accessible; raises VALIDATION_ERROR if fields are invalid or a requested status transition is not allowed (active->resolved/cancelled, resolved->active).

incident_id.description: Internal incident id (ULID) in the incidents collection.

labels.description: Key/value labels to apply to the incident (replaces or merges per implementation).

status.description: Updated incident status. Setting this drives lifecycle transitions.

tool_schemas.name: get_caller_identity
tool_schemas.description: Returns the authenticated caller identity for this connector, including effective scopes/permissions and current quota or rate-limit consumption if available. Refuses unauthenticated requests and returns only information for the calling principal (no impersonation).

include_quota.description: Whether to include current quota/rate-limit consumption details when available.
